title: 2014 AMC 10A Problem 22
statement: In rectangle \(ABCD,\) \(\overline{AB}=20\) and \(\overline{BC}=10.\) Let \(E\) be a point on \(\overline{CD}\) such that \(\angle CBE=15^\circ.\) What is \(\overline{AE}?\)

solutions.text:
Let \(E'\) be the point on \(\overline{CD}\) such that \(AE'=AB=20\).

Since \(AD=10\), triangle \(ADE'\) is a \(30\)-\(60\)-\(90\) triangle, so \(\angle DAE'=60^\circ\) and \(\angle BAE'=30^\circ\).

Also \(AE'=AB\), so triangle \(ABE'\) is isosceles. Its vertex angle at \(A\) is \(30^\circ\), so each base angle is \(75^\circ\).

Therefore \(\angle CBE'=90^\circ-75^\circ=15^\circ\), so \(E'=E\), and \(AE=20\).

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Construct a helpful point making a \(30\)-\(60\)-\(90\) triangle
Show the constructed point is the same as \(E\)
